newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London drop, worries over banks.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London drop, worries over banks.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London dropped on Thursday as worries over the banking sector persisted overnight from Tokyo, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 index was at 1,348.81 by 1600 GMT, down 22.40 points from Wednesday's London close. The Nikkei 225 closed down 471.26 points or 2.57 percent overnight, ending at 17,864.04.
"We've seen a reversal of the trend seem in the last few days where people were looking to pick up bargains in the banking sector. I think any hope of that recovering has gone now," one dealer said.
"I think people are fairly disappointed they couldn't hold onto gains made in the past few days," he added.
Dealers said there were still buyers around for blue chips like Toshiba and Canon. Toyota was also well bid after falling overnight, they said.
